The issue in the provided code is that it incorrectly counts the number of buildings shorter than the first building and uses this count to determine if there is a taller building. Instead, we should directly check if there is any building taller than the first one and print the position of the first such building. If no such building exists, we should print `-1`.

Here is the patch to fix the issue:

cad=[int(x) for x in input().split()]

- Introduced a `found` variable to track if a taller building has been found.
- If a taller building is found, print its position and set `found` to `True`.
- After the loop, if no taller building was found, print `-1`.
